detail.longDescription: Just had a peek on "The Farmer Was Replaced". Mainly out of curiosity. It looks like a nice way to teach Python and algorithmic thinking. You have a research tree where you can unlock language features and need to gather resources for that. To harvest resources you need to consider their constraints. And you should read the docs carefully, like in real life. A nice idea which does not overwhelm and introduces you slowly. https:// store.steampowered.com/app/206 0160/The_Farmer_Was_Replaced/ # Python # programming # learnig
